description: BUYS the portraits for a cast draft: one image generation per member that still needs a face, at the chosen image model's rate, then saves every member to the user's character library. The cast's paid step (the webapp's 'Generate cast' button). WHEN: the user has READ the draft from `generate_cast`, accepted it, and said go to the price. Take the figures from the draft's own `portrait_models` (`per_portrait_tokens`, `total_tokens`), never from memory (a cast portrait prices differently from an ordinary image): 'portraits: 3 on <default> = <total_tokens> T, or <other> at <per_portrait_tokens> each. Go?'. `estimate_only: true` re-prices against the CURRENT catalog if the draft has sat a while. OFFER THE IMAGE MODEL ONCE, in a line you are already writing (not an interview): name the model that draws the pictures in plain words with its default and price; no preference means the series' default. THE CARD: this call already put the aicut cast card up, each portrait filling in as it generates: do not poll or call `show_generation` (one `get_image` read of `portrait_image_id` if asked). No card (a terminal)? Poll each `generating` member's `portrait_image_id` with `wait_for_generation` (media `image`) and give the urls. AFTER: portraits generate asynchronously, only for members that needed one. `portrait_status: "ready"` with a null `portrait_image_id` was NOT generated and NOT charged (it arrived photographed, or already had a face): not missing. A member whose `id` is null could not be saved and cannot be a `cast_member_id`. `charged_tokens` is what moved. One face wrong: `regenerate_cast_portrait`; one CHARACTER wrong: `describe_cast_member`; a fresh `generate_cast` is a different cast and a new charge. THE DRAFT IS SPENT once this succeeds: a repeat with the same `draft_id` answers 404 `cast_draft_not_found` or a 201 with `charged_tokens: 0` (nothing bought): report it as 'already done', never as a second purchase. IF IT REFUSES PART WAY (402 or a cap): the portraits already generated WERE charged (`partial_cast: true`, `portraits_minted`, `charged_tokens`): tell the user that number, never 'nothing was charged'. Retrying the SAME `draft_id` generates and charges only the missing members. A 400 naming `draft_id` means what you passed is not a cast draft id (a job id, a member id): re-read `generate_cast`'s response; there is no other route to a draft. SPENDS TOKENS: price with `estimate_only: true`, ask in the SAME message as the price, and wait for a go that names THIS purchase (SPENDING RULES, this server's instructions).

portrait_model.description: One of the draft's `portrait_models` ids. It draws the faces: name it with the price (see OFFER THE IMAGE MODEL), then omit it if the user has no preference (`default: true` is what the series is tuned for).

name: generate_cast_portraits
